LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening
Topic 1.7: Imitative speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Imitative speaking, part of Listening in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why do we imitate?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to parts of the body and repeat after,

2. listen to activities for body parts (z.B sehen, sprechen, schreiben) and match to pictures,

3. listen to texts on functions of the body and repeat (z.B Ich brauche die Augen zum Sehen/zum Sehen brauche ich die Augen)

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to parts of the body and repeat after,
2. listen to activities for body parts (z.B sehen, sprechen, schreiben) and match to pictures,
3. listen to texts on functions of the body and repeat (z.B Ich brauche die Augen zum Sehen/zum Sehen brauche ich die Augen)

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Imitative speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: The learner develops confidence and self-awareness as they make presentations to peers on parts of the body

and their functions.

Values:
Respect: The learner practices self-respect and respect for others’ bodies when they listen to texts on body parts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Human Sexuality: The learner interacts with listening texts that promote the awareness of Human Sexuality.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of body parts to the same concept in Science and Technology.
